Package com.codeup.novabook.service.impl

Class LoanServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.service.impl.LoanServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
ILoanService
public class LoanServiceImpl extends Object implements ILoanService
Service implementation for Loan management with full transaction support.

This is the CRITICAL service that implements atomic loan operations using JdbcTemplateLight's transaction management (txExecute).

    • createLoan

      public Loan createLoan(Integer memberId, Integer bookId, LocalDate dueDate) throws MemberNotFoundException, BookNotFoundException, BookNotAvailableException, ValidationException
      Description copied from interface: ILoanService
      Creates a new loan with TRANSACTION MANAGEMENT.

      This method implements the LibroNova requirement: "Usar transacciones: Préstamo → setAutoCommit(false) → insertar préstamo → actualizar stock → commit() / rollback()"

      Transaction Steps:

      1. Validate member exists and status = ACTIVE
      2. Check member hasn't reached maximum active loans
      3. Validate book exists, is_active = true, and stock > 0
      4. Decrease book stock by 1
      5. Create loan record with status = ACTIVE
      6. Commit transaction (or rollback on any error)
      Specified by:
      createLoan in interface ILoanService
      Parameters:
      memberId - the member ID requesting the loan
      bookId - the book ID to loan
      dueDate - the loan due date (must be in the future)
      Returns:
      the created Loan with generated ID
      Throws:
      MemberNotFoundException - if member doesn't exist or is not active
      BookNotFoundException - if book doesn't exist
      BookNotAvailableException - if book is inactive or stock = 0
      ValidationException - if member has reached max loans or due date is invalid

    • returnLoan

      public Loan returnLoan(Integer loanId, BigDecimal fineRatePerDay) throws LoanNotFoundException, LoanAlreadyClosedException
      Description copied from interface: ILoanService
      Returns a loan with TRANSACTION MANAGEMENT.

      Transaction Steps:

      1. Validate loan exists and status = ACTIVE
      2. Calculate fine if overdue (days late * fine rate)
      3. Update loan: status = CLOSED, return_date = today, fine_amount
      4. Increase book stock by 1
      5. Commit transaction (or rollback on error)
      Specified by:
      returnLoan in interface ILoanService
      Parameters:
      loanId - the loan ID to return
      fineRatePerDay - the fine rate per day overdue (e.g., 0.50 for $0.50/day)
      Returns:
      the updated Loan with fine amount (if any)
      Throws:
      LoanNotFoundException - if loan doesn't exist
      LoanAlreadyClosedException - if loan is already closed

    • calculateFine

      public BigDecimal calculateFine(Integer loanId, BigDecimal fineRatePerDay) throws LoanNotFoundException
      Description copied from interface: ILoanService
      Calculates the fine for an overdue loan.

      Formula: fine = max(0, days_overdue) * fine_rate_per_day

      Days overdue = current_date - due_date (if positive, else 0)

      Specified by:
      calculateFine in interface ILoanService
      Parameters:
      loanId - the loan ID
      fineRatePerDay - the fine rate per day (e.g., 0.50)
      Returns:
      the calculated fine amount (0.00 if not overdue)
      Throws:
      LoanNotFoundException - if loan doesn't exist

      public List<Loan> getOverdueLoans()
      Description copied from interface: ILoanService
      Retrieves all currently overdue loans.

      A loan is overdue if: - status = ACTIVE - due_date < current_date

      Used for CSV export as per LibroNova requirement: "Exportar a CSV: Catálogo y préstamos vencidos"
